mapper.select: SELECT withdraw_id, member_id, mchid, appid, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, amount_fen, openid, remark, request_version, request_hash, balance_before, balance_after, submit_time IS NOT NULL AS submitted, local_rejection_time IS NOT NULL AS locally_rejected FROM member_cash_withdraw_transfer_intent WHERE withdraw_id = #{withdrawId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_cash_withdraw_transfer_intent (withdraw_id, member_id, mchid, appid, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, amount_fen, openid, remark, request_version, request_hash, balance_before, balance_after) VALUES (#{withdrawId}, #{memberId}, #{mchid}, #{appid}, #{outBatchNo}, #{outDetailNo}, #{amountFen}, #{openid}, #{remark}, #{requestVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter})
mapper.update: UPDATE member_cash_withdraw_transfer_intent SET submit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} AND submit_time IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_cash_withdraw w WHERE w.id = #{withdrawId} AND w.status = 0 AND w.del_flag = 0 AND (w.frozen IS NULL OR w.frozen = 0))
